{{Quote|And if we assume that he uses consistent tactics in his illegal activities, well, right next to the base, between it and the city, is a peak called Black Crest Mountain, which has extensive played-out mines beneath it. Old maps show that some of those tunnels reach as far as the new base south and into the city north.|Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Black Crest Mountain''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. It used to be mined for precious metals and gems but was depleted by [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]].<ref name="MK" />
